question:
Please track the performance of political organizations that emphasize the importance of social homogeneity, question the value of international cooperation, and tend to attribute social issues to external influences in the United Kingdom, France, and Germany in all presidential (first round) elections held from 2010 through 2024 (including 2024). For each election, record the following details: Year, Country, Party, Party President during the election (if the party does not have a president, record the leader(s)/chairman), Popular Vote (number of votes won by the party or its presidential candidate), Vote Share (%, to keep one digit), Winning Party / bloc (overall victor of the election)

Please output the organized data in the format of one Markdown table.
The column names in the table are as follows in sequence:
Year, Country, Party, Party President, Popular Vote, Vote Share(%), Winning Party/ Bloc

Don't ask me any questions, just output the results according to the columns without omitting cells arbitrarily. The output format is ```markdown
{data_content}
```.
